summary.text: Keith Grover is a Republican state senator from Utah who has represented District 23 since 2018 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a junior high school administrator in the Alpine School District and served in the Utah House of Representatives from 2007 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Keith Grover earned a B.S. from Brigham Young University and an M.Ed. from the University of Utah, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes work as a school administrator.
Grover represented District 61 in the Utah House of Representatives from 2007 to 2018 before moving to the Senate.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Senate Education, Ethics, Health and Human Services, Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment, and Rules committees.
